name: Order Tracking & Delivery Delay
description: Inquiries regarding package shipping status, estimated delivery dates, carrier delays, or tracking issues.
examples: Where is my package? It was supposed to be delivered yesterday! Order #112-8874921.
My tracking says 'Out for delivery' since 8 AM but nothing showed up. Any updates?
Can you tell me the carrier tracking number for order #114-9923812? Status is stuck on dispatched.
The delivery driver marked my package as delivered, but I checked my porch, mailbox, and neighbors and nothing is there.
labeling_rules: Classify as 'order_tracking' if customer inquires about order tracking & delivery delay.

name: Refund & Return Inquiries
description: Questions about return drop-off, return labels, refund status, and refund processing timeframes.
examples: I returned my shoes 7 days ago via UPS drop-off. When will my refund be processed to my card?
Can I get a return label for order #113-8829102? The item does not fit properly.
My return was delivered to your fulfillment center on Tuesday according to tracking, but no refund notification yet.
How long does it take for a refund to show up on my original payment method after return?
labeling_rules: Classify as 'refund_returns' if customer inquires about refund & return inquiries.

name: Damaged / Defective / Wrong Item
description: Reports of items arriving broken, opened, missing components, or receiving the incorrect item.
examples: My glass vase arrived completely shattered into pieces! The box had zero bubble wrap. Order #112-9988112.
The laptop screen has vertical lines across it right out of the sealed box. It is defective.
I ordered a blue coffee maker, but you sent me a red blender instead! Wrong item delivered.
The shampoo bottle leaked all over the rest of my book order inside the package. Everything is ruined.
labeling_rules: Classify as 'damaged_defective' if customer inquires about damaged / defective / wrong item.

name: Payment & Billing Inquiries
description: Double charges, unrecognized transaction lines, payment authorization failures, or gift card balance queries.
examples: I was charged twice on my credit card for order #114-8877112! $89.99 charged two times.
Why is there a pending charge of $14.99 from Amazon Digital on my bank statement that I did not authorize?
My card payment failed at checkout even though there are sufficient funds and the card is active.
I applied a $50 gift card balance to my order, but my credit card was still charged the full amount.
labeling_rules: Classify as 'payment_billing' if customer inquires about payment & billing inquiries.

name: Account Access & Security Alerts
description: Unauthorized account login, password reset lockout, 2FA issues, or suspected account compromise.
examples: URGENT: Someone unauthorized logged into my Amazon account from another country and changed my shipping address!
I received an OTP verification code on my phone that I did not request. Is someone trying to hack my account?
My account has been locked due to suspicious activity, and I cannot access my Kindle library or pending orders.
Someone placed $800 worth of gift card orders on my account without my permission! Cancel them now!
labeling_rules: Classify as 'account_security' if customer inquires about account access & security alerts.

name: Prime Membership & Subscriptions
description: Prime membership fees, subscription renewal, cancelling Prime, Prime Video access, or student discounts.
examples: I was charged $139 for an annual Prime renewal without any reminder email. I want to cancel and get a refund.
How do I pause or cancel my Prime membership before the next billing cycle?
My Prime Video app says I don't have an active subscription, but I paid for Amazon Prime yesterday.
Can I share my Prime shipping benefits with my spouse through Amazon Household?
labeling_rules: Classify as 'subscription_prime' if customer inquires about prime membership & subscriptions.

name: Order Cancellation Requests
description: Requesting to cancel an order before dispatch or dealing with cancelled items.
examples: I ordered an item 10 minutes ago by mistake. How do I cancel order #114-7766554 before it ships?
The cancellation button is greyed out on my order page. Can you please cancel order #112-9933441?
I requested a cancellation yesterday, but today I got a notification that the item has shipped!
Can I cancel one single item out of an order with 3 items?
labeling_rules: Classify as 'cancellation' if customer inquires about order cancellation requests.

name: Product & Stock Inquiries
description: Questions about product compatibility, seller warranty, restock dates, or technical specifications.
examples: Is the Kindle Paperwhite waterproof, and what is the battery life between charges?
When will the 256GB Space Gray tablet be back in stock from the official Amazon seller?
Does this Bluetooth speaker come with a manufacturer warranty in the US?
Is this phone case compatible with the wireless charging pad for iPhone 15?
labeling_rules: Classify as 'product_inquiry' if customer inquires about product & stock inquiries.

name: Human Agent / Supervisor Request
description: Explicit customer demands to speak directly to a live representative, human agent, manager, or supervisor.
examples: I refuse to talk to an automated bot! Transfer me to a real human customer support agent right now.
Connect me with a supervisor or manager immediately. This issue has been going on for 3 weeks.
Can someone from Amazon customer service please call my phone number? I need a human.
Your automated system is completely useless. Give me an actual representative.
labeling_rules: Classify as 'human_escalation_request' if customer inquires about human agent / supervisor request.

name: Driver Feedback & Service Complaints
description: Escalated complaints regarding rude delivery drivers, package mishandling, or systemic customer service dissatisfaction.
examples: Your delivery driver threw my package over an 8-foot locked gate onto the concrete driveway and broke it!
Driver left my package on the street curb in heavy rain instead of walking to the covered porch.
I want to file a formal complaint against the delivery carrier for reckless driving in our residential neighborhood.
Terrible customer service experience on the phone today. The representative hung up on me after 45 minutes on hold.
labeling_rules: Classify as 'feedback_complaint' if customer inquires about driver feedback & service complaints.
